decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric program is central to the firm's mental health services and has a dedicated page, so strong public commitment and accumulated investment make withdrawal very unlikely.

The carpentry workshop has its own page and draws on established production know-how, so visible investment and the need to justify the prior decision make persistence likely despite being less clinical.

Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's core support services, and although only mentioned on the website, the firm will likely persist to justify the earlier launch and maintain mental health offerings.

Meal delivery is a newer service with only a website mention, so it has less accumulated commitment, but its proximity to core eldercare and the need to justify the 2024 launch make persistence moderately likely.
